framework: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India) + DPDP Rules, 2025
description: vCISO client questionnaire covering the Data-Fiduciary-facing obligations of the DPDP Act, 2023 (Chapters 1-4, ss.3-17) and the operative DPDP Rules, 2025 that bind Data Fiduciaries/Processors. Chapters 5-9 of the Act (ss.18-44, Data Protection Board / Appellate Tribunal constitution, powers and procedure) and the Board/Tribunal-internal Rules are summarized for context only, not scored.

key_dates.phase_2_effective: 13 November 2026 (Rule 4 — Consent Manager registration; s.6(9), s.27(1)(d))

scoring_model.logic: Each question's selected option carries a 'status'. Roll up per section/rule: PASS if 'yes', PARTIAL if 'partial', FAIL if 'no', N/A if 'na' (excluded from scoring, requires justification). Each question also carries 'penalty_exposure' — the maximum Schedule penalty tied to that obligation — so failed items can be sorted by regulatory risk, not just by count.

questions.title: Application of the Act
questions.question: Has your organization determined whether the DPDP Act applies to its processing activities — i.e. processing of digital personal data within India, personal data collected non-digitally and later digitized, or processing outside India connected to offering goods/services to individuals in India — and documented this applicability assessment (including any personal/domestic-use or publicly-available-data exclusions relied on)?
questions.penalty_exposure: Up to ₹50 crore (Schedule item 7 — breach of any other provision of the Act/Rules)

options.label: Yes – fully implemented, documented, and operating effectively
Partially – in place but not fully documented, consistently applied, or effective
No – not implemented
Not Applicable – (justification required)
